content.title: Visit the Amazing Spaceship Set of 'Project Hail Mary' w/ Adam Savage | FirstShowing.net
content.text: by March 15, 2026Source: YouTube "The sets need to be able to perform with him. And give him things to do. That has always been one of our mantras on the film." Step inside the Hail Mary set where Ryan Gosling performed making this stunning sci-fi movie. Fellow geek Adam Savage has debuted a series of videos on his YT channel "Adam Savage's Tested" recently featuring his visit to the set of Phil Lord & Chris Miller's movie Project Hail Mary. With the release worldwide this month, they're finally allowed to show us what it was like on set. So much of this movie was made by hand with as little green screen as possible. Adapted from Andy Weir's acclaimed novel of the same name, this is the story of a teacher turned astronaut who tries to save Earth while alone in outer space. The movie stars Ryan Gosling as Ryland Grace, who wakes up on a spacecraft at Tau Ceti and has to figure out how to save our stars with the help of a new friend. This video features Adam Savage talking with production designer Charles Wood (aka "Charlie") who then takes him on a tour of the production - from model to sound stage. Charlie explains how the Boeing 747-8 button design inspired the buttons on this set, along with everything else about how it works. This is awesome! I love seeing all this actual design work and how much goes into make a movie. Incredible. This movie totally rules. Don't miss seeing it in theaters soon. Here's Adam Savage's set visit videos for Lord & Miller's sci-fi movie Project Hail Mary, from YouTube: Rewatch the first trailer for Lord & Miller's Project Hail Mary right here and second trailer + final trailer. Astronaut Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) awakens with no memory of himself or his mission. He deduces he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti solar system in search of a solution to a catastrophic event on Earth. In his search for answers, Grace must rely on his vast array of scientific knowledge, sheer ingenuity, and human will – but he may not have to search alone. Project Hail Mary is directed by the two acclaimed producers / writers / filmmakers Phil Lord & Christopher Miller (known as Lord & Miller), director of the films Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs, 21 Jump Street, The Lego Movie, and 22 Jump Street previously, plus "The Afterparty" series most recently. The screenplay is written by Drew Goddard (of Cloverfield, The Cabin in the Woods, World War Z, The Martian, Bad Times at the El Royale) with Andy Weird. Based on Andy Weir's novel of the same name first published in 2021. It's produced by Ryan Gosling, Rachel O'Connor, Amy Pascal, Aditya Sood, Andy Weir, Lord/Miller. Amazon MGM Studios + Sony Pictures will debut Lord & Miller's Project Hail Mary in theaters worldwide starting March 20th, 2026 coming up. Find more posts in: Featurette, Sci-Fi, To Watch, Trailer
